parts.name: Fan Blades
parts.Basic_description: This is the fan blade assembly made of aluminum, consisting of multiple blades attached to a central hub.
parts.Functional_description: The fan blades rotate to move air through the system, providing ventilation or cooling.
parts.Movement_description: The blades rotate around the central axis when powered by the motor.

parts.name: Switch (Other)
parts.Basic_description: This is the control switch made of plastic, used to turn the fan on or off.
parts.Functional_description: It controls the electrical circuit, allowing the user to start or stop the fan motor.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly when toggled or pressed by the user to change the fan’s operational state.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the fan, made of steel, supporting the motor and blades.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and houses the motor and fan assembly securely.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.
